articles.title_en: On bargaining norms as solutions to cost-minimization problems
articles.title_cn: 论作为成本最小化问题解的讨价还价规范
authors: Tatur, Tymon (Department of Economics, University of Bonn)
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies bargaining outcomes in economies in which agents may be able to impose outcomes that deviate from the relevant social norms but incur costs when they do so. It characterizes bargaining outcomes that are easiest for a society to sustain as part of a social norm which everybody will want to follow. Depending on technological assumptions, the approach yields the Nash bargaining solution, the Kalai-Smorodinsky solution, the equal monetary split, and other bargaining solutions. Set-valued solution concepts are derived that are relevant if one is unable or unwilling to make specific technological assumptions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究在代理人可能能够强加偏离相关社会规范的结果、但这样做会产生成本的经济体中的讨价还价结果。它刻画了作为社会规范的一部分最容易被社会维持、且每个人都愿意遵循的讨价还价结果。取决于技术假设，该方法得出纳什讨价还价解、卡莱-斯莫罗丁斯基解、等额货币分配以及其他讨价还价解。推导出在无法或不愿做出具体技术假设时相关的集值解概念。

articles.title_en: Innovation adoption by forward-looking social learners
articles.title_cn: 前瞻性社会学习者的创新采纳
authors: Frick, Mira (Department of Economics, Princeton University)
Ishii, Yuhta (Department of Economics, Pennsylvania State University)
articles.abstract_en: We build a model studying the effect of an economy's potential for social learning on the adoption of innovations of uncertain quality. Assuming consumers are forward-looking (i.e.,\ recognize the value of waiting for information), we analyze how qualitative and quantitative features of the learning environment affect equilibrium adoption dynamics, welfare, and the speed of learning. Based on this, we show how differences in the learning environment translate into observable differences in adoption dynamics, suggesting a purely informational channel for two commonly documented adoption patterns---S-shaped and concave curves. We also identify environments that are subject to a saturation effect: Increased opportunities for social learning can slow down adoption and learning and do not increase consumer welfare, possibly even being harmful.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个模型，研究一个经济体的社会学习潜力对质量不确定的创新采纳的影响。假设消费者是前瞻性的（即认识到等待信息的价值），我们分析学习环境的定性和定量特征如何影响均衡采纳动态、福利和学习速度。在此基础上，我们展示了学习环境的差异如何转化为可观察的采纳动态差异，为两种常见记录的采纳模式——S形曲线和凹形曲线——提出了一个纯信息渠道。我们还识别了受饱和效应影响的环境：社会学习机会的增加会减缓采纳和学习，并且不会增加消费者福利，甚至可能有害。

articles.title_en: Robust predictions in dynamic policy games
articles.title_cn: 动态政策博弈中的稳健预测
authors: Passadore, Juan (IMF, Western Hemisphere Department)
Xandri Antuna, Juan Pablo (Department of Economics, Universidad de Los Andes, Chile)
articles.abstract_en: Dynamic policy games feature a wide range of equilibria. This paper provides a methodology for obtaining robust predictions. We focus on a model of sovereign debt, although our methodology applies to other settings, such as models of monetary policy or capital taxation. Our main result is a characterization of distributions over outcomes that are consistent with a subgame perfect equilibrium conditional on the observed history. We illustrate our main result by computing, conditional on an observed history, bounds across all equilibria on: the maximum probability of a crisis, means, variances, and covariances over debt prices.
articles.abstract_cn: 动态政策博弈具有广泛的均衡。本文提供了一种获得稳健预测的方法。我们聚焦于一个主权债务模型，尽管我们的方法适用于其他设定，例如货币政策或资本税模型。我们的主要结果是刻画了在给定观测历史条件下与子博弈完美均衡一致的关于结果的分布。我们通过计算在给定观测历史条件下，跨所有均衡的以下界限来说明我们的主要结果：危机最大概率、债务价格的均值、方差和协方差。

articles.title_en: The property rights theory of production networks
authors: Balbuzanov, Ivan (Department of Economics, University of Melbourne)
Kotowski, Maciej H. (Department of Economics, University of Notre Dame)
Ivan Balbuzanov
Maciej Kotowski
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the formation of production and trading networks in economies with general interdependencies and complex property rights. We argue that the right to exclude, a core tenet of property, grants asset owners local monopoly power that is amplified by an economy's endogenous production network. Our analysis generalizes the exclusion core, a cooperative solution concept based on the right to exclude, to markets with production. We identify sufficient (and essentially necessary) conditions for the nonemptiness of the exclusion core. Multisourcing and a bias toward shorter supply chains emerge in exclusion-core outcomes. As a methodological contribution, we generalize the top trading cycles algorithm to a production economy and we show that it identifies outcomes in an economy's exclusion core.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了具有一般相互依赖性和复杂产权的经济体中的生产和交易网络的形成。我们认为，排除权作为产权的核心原则，赋予资产所有者局部垄断势力，而这种势力被经济体的内生生产网络所放大。我们的分析将排除核——一种基于排除权的合作解概念——推广到有生产的市场。我们确定了排除核非空的充分（且本质上是必要）条件。多源采购和对较短供应链的偏好出现在排除核结果中。作为方法论贡献，我们将最高交易循环算法推广到生产经济体，并表明它识别出经济体排除核中的结果。

articles.title_en: Auction design with data-driven misspecifications: inefficiency in private value auctions with correlation
articles.title_cn: 数据驱动的错误设定下的拍卖设计：具有相关性的私人价值拍卖中的无效率
authors: Jehiel, Philippe (Department of Economics, PSE and UCL)
Mierendorff, Konrad (Department of Economics, University College London)
Philippe Jehiel
Konrad Mierendorff †
articles.abstract_en: We study the existence of efficient auctions in private value settings in which some bidders form their expectations about the distribution of their competitor’s bids based on the accessible data from past similar auctions consisting of bids and ex post values. We consider steady-states in such environments with a mix of rational and data-driven bidders, and we allow for correlation across bidders in the signal distributions about the ex post values. After reviewing the working of the approach in second-price and first-price auctions, we show our main result that there is no efficient auction in such environments.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究在私人价值设定中有效拍卖的存在性，其中一些投标人根据来自过去类似拍卖的可获取数据（包括出价和事后价值）形成对竞争对手出价分布的预期。我们考虑此类环境中理性投标人和数据驱动投标人混合的稳态，并允许关于事后价值的信号分布中投标人之间存在相关性。在回顾了该方法在第二价格拍卖和第一价格拍卖中的运作之后，我们展示了我们的主要结果：在此类环境中不存在有效拍卖。

articles.title_cn: 社会选择中的扩展测量
authors: Nebel, Jacob M. (Department of Philosophy, Princeton University)
articles.abstract_en: Extensive measurement is the standard measurement-theoretic approach for constructing a ratio scale. It involves the comparison of objects that can be concatenated in an additively representable way. This paper studies the implications of extensively measurable welfare for social choice theory. We do this in two frameworks: an Arrovian framework with a fixed population and no interpersonal comparisons, and a generalized framework with variable populations and full interpersonal comparability. In each framework we use extensive measurement to introduce novel domain restrictions, independence conditions, and constraints on social evaluation. We prove a welfarism theorem for these domains and characterize the social welfare functions that satisfy the axioms of extensive measurement at both the individual and social levels. The main results are simple axiomatizations of strong dictatorship in the Arrovian framework and classical utilitarianism in the generalized framework.
articles.abstract_cn: 扩展测量是构建比率尺度的标准测量理论方法。它涉及对能够以可加表示方式连接的对象进行比较。本文研究可扩展测量的福利对社会选择理论的含义。我们在两个框架中进行研究：一个具有固定人口且无人际比较的阿罗框架，以及一个具有可变人口和完全人际可比性的广义框架。在每个框架中，我们使用扩展测量来引入新的域限制、独立性条件和社会评价约束。我们为这些域证明了一个福利主义定理，并刻画了在个人和社会层面均满足扩展测量公理的社会福利函数。主要结果是阿罗框架中强独裁和广义框架中古典功利主义的简单公理化。

authors: Kocourek, Pavel (Department of Microeconomics at University Duisburg-Essen)
Steiner, Jakub (Department of economics at University of Zurich, CERGE-EI, and CTS)
Stewart, Colin (Department of Economics, University of Toronto)
Jakub Steiner
Colin Stewart
articles.abstract_en: Evidence suggests that consumers do not perfectly optimize, contrary to a critical assumption of classical consumer theory. We propose a model in which consumer types can vary in both their preferences and their choice behavior. Given data on demand and the distribution of prices, we identify the set of possible values of the consumer surplus based on minimal rationality conditions: every type of consumer must be no worse off than if they either always bought the good or never did. We develop a procedure to narrow the set of surplus values using richer datasets and provide bounds on counterfactual demands.
articles.abstract_cn: 证据表明，消费者并非完美优化，这与经典消费者理论的一个关键假设相悖。我们提出一个模型，其中消费者类型可以在其偏好和选择行为两方面存在差异。基于需求和价格分布数据，我们根据最小理性条件识别消费者剩余的可能取值集合：每一种消费者类型都必须不劣于他们要么总是购买该商品、要么从不购买该商品的情形。我们开发了一种程序，利用更丰富的数据集来缩小剩余价值的集合，并提供反事实需求的界限。

articles.title_en: An axiomatic characterization of Nash equilibrium
articles.title_cn: 纳什均衡的公理化刻画
authors: Brandl, Florian (Department of Economics, University of Bonn)
Brandt, Felix (Department of Computer Science, Technische Universität München)
articles.abstract_en: We characterize Nash equilibrium by postulating coherent behavior across varying games. Nash equilibrium is the only solution concept that satisfies the following axioms:(i) strictly dominant actions are played with positive probability, (ii) if a strategy profile is played in two games, it is also played in every convex combination of these games, and (iii) players can shift probability arbitrarily between two indistinguishable actions, and deleting one of these actions has no effect. Our theorem implies that every equilibrium refinement violates at least one of these axioms. Moreover, every solution concept that approximately satisfies these axioms returns approximate Nash equilibria, even in natural subclasses of games, such as two-player zero-sum games, potential games, and graphical games.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过假设在不同博弈中的一致行为来刻画纳什均衡。纳什均衡是唯一满足以下公理的解概念：(i) 严格占优行动以正概率被采用，(ii) 如果一个策略组合在两个博弈中被采用，那么它在这两个博弈的每个凸组合中也被采用，以及 (iii) 参与人可以在两个不可区分的行动之间任意转移概率，且删除其中一个行动没有影响。我们的定理意味着每个均衡精炼都至少违反这些公理之一。此外，每个近似满足这些公理的解概念都返回近似纳什均衡，即使在自然的博弈子类中也是如此，例如两人零和博弈、势博弈和图博弈。

authors: Dworczak, Piotr (Department of Economics, Northwestern University)
Kolotilin, Anton (School of Economics, UNSW Business School)
Piotr Dworczak
Anton Kolotilin
articles.abstract_en: We present a unified duality approach to Bayesian persuasion. The optimal dual variable, interpreted as a price function on the state space, is shown to be a supergradient of the concave closure of the objective function at the prior belief. Strong duality holds when the objective function is Lipschitz continuous. When the objective depends on the posterior belief through a set of moments, the price function induces prices for posterior moments that solve the corresponding dual problem. Thus, our general approach unifies known results for one-dimensional moment persuasion, while yielding new results for the multi-dimensional case. In particular, we provide a condition for the optimality of convex-partitional signals, derive structural properties of solutions, and characterize the optimal persuasion scheme when the state is two-dimensional and the objective is quadratic.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出一种统一的贝叶斯说服对偶方法。最优对偶变量被解释为状态空间上的价格函数，并证明其为目标函数的凹闭包在先验信念处的超梯度。当目标函数是Lipschitz连续时，强对偶性成立。当目标通过一组矩依赖于后验信念时，价格函数诱导出后验矩的价格，这些价格求解相应的对偶问题。因此，我们的通用方法统一了已知的一维矩说服结果，同时为多维情形产生了新结果。特别地，我们给出了凸划分信号最优性的一个条件，推导了解的结构性质，并刻画了当状态是二维且目标为二次型时的最优说服方案。

articles.title_en: Distributions of posterior quantiles via matching
articles.title_cn: 通过匹配实现后验分位数的分布
authors: Kolotilin, Anton (School of Economics, UNSW Business School)
Wolitzky, Alexander (Department of Economics, MIT)
Anton Kolotilin
Alexander Wolitzky
articles.abstract_en: We offer a simple analysis of the problem of choosing a statistical experiment to optimize the induced distribution of posterior medians, or more generally q-quantiles for any q ∈ (0,1). We show that a single experiment---the q-quantile matching experiment---implements all implementable distributions of posterior q-quantiles, with different distributions spanned by different selections from the sets of posterior q-quantiles. A dense subset of implementable distributions of posterior q-quantiles can be uniquely implemented by perturbing the q-quantile matching experiment. A linear functional is optimized over distributions of posterior q-quantiles by taking the optimal selection from each set of posterior q-quantiles. The q-quantile matching experiment is the only experiment that simultaneously implements all implementable distributions of posterior q-quantiles.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个简单的分析，用于选择统计实验以优化后验中位数，或更一般地，对于任意 q ∈ (0,1) 的 q-分位数的诱导分布的问题。我们表明，一个单一实验——q-分位数匹配实验——实现了所有可实现的后验 q-分位数分布，不同的分布由来自后验 q-分位数集合的不同选择所张成。可实现的后验 q-分位数分布的一个稠密子集可以通过扰动 q-分位数匹配实验来唯一实现。通过从每个后验 q-分位数集合中取最优选择，线性泛函在后验 q-分位数分布上得到优化。q-分位数匹配实验是唯一同时实现所有可实现的后验 q-分位数分布的实验。
